title: FpsFixer
description: Enhance Minecraft performance with higher FPS, reduced stuttering, and smoother gameplay while maintaining the vanilla experience.
body:
# FPS Fixer

FPS Fixer is a lightweight Minecraft optimization mod designed to improve game performance and reduce lag without changing the vanilla gameplay experience.

## Features

* Increased FPS and smoother gameplay
* Reduced stuttering and frame drops
* Optimized rendering performance
* Lightweight and easy to install
* Compatible with most modpacks
* Works on low-end and high-end PCs

## Why Use FPS Fixer?

FPS Fixer helps Minecraft run more efficiently by optimizing performance-related systems, allowing players to enjoy higher frame rates and a smoother experience. Whether you're exploring large worlds, building massive structures, or playing on multiplayer servers, FPS Fixer can help improve overall game responsiveness.

## Installation

1. Install the required mod loader.
2. Download the latest version of FPS Fixer.
3. Place the mod file into your Minecraft `mods` folder.
4. Launch the game and enjoy improved performance.

## Compatibility

FPS Fixer is designed to work alongside most optimization and quality-of-life mods. For the best results, keep the mod updated to the latest version.

Boost your FPS and enjoy a smoother Minecraft experience with FPS Fixer!
